Fall 3, Coral Island
By Tomas Wira, Pokyo Daily Correspondent

Years after the tragic drowning of their son, the grieving parents continue to return to Coral Island. Locals say the visits are welcome, expressing sympathy and solidarity with the family’s enduring loss.

contentText.SourceString:
Regulation 14.3 — Maximum number of goats allowed in a canoe: 2.

This ordinance was passed after multiple incidents of capsized boats at sea. Local farmers had been attempting to transport entire herds by water, resulting in damage to property and, in one case, a goat being rescued from the lighthouse pier.

To ensure the safety of both livestock and passengers, all watercraft must comply with this limit. Anyone caught exceeding the limit will be fined one basket of fresh produce and ordered to attend a mandatory 'Safe Boating with Goats' workshop.
